page.overview:
Who is Abdar?

Abdar was a legendary spicemonger from Marquet who helped fund the construction of Emon, the capital city of Tal'Dorei. His name is synonymous with generosity and business savvy; Abdar's Promenade, a marketplace district in Emon, was named after him. The street has been mentioned on-stream multiple times, but Abdar himself has neither been mentioned nor appeared on Critical Role.

Category:Merchants Category:Unspecified Humanoids
